doc_errors.wrong: '<MediaElement> -> <MediaPlayerElement>: Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames.'
doc_errors.correct: MediaPlayerElement.Source is IMediaPlaybackSource, not Uri; MediaElement.SetSource(stream, contentType) has no equivalent -> use MediaSource.CreateFromUri/CreateFromStream.
